topic: c-new-layout-r4: positive control cannot pass at the 100 cm side-facing geometry
what_passed: 0.30 s microphone pre-checks (peak well below -6 dBFS)
what_failed: the packaged positive control: a 1.02 s gate tone played from the speaker at 100 cm side-facing does not produce a detectable tone at the microphone above the room noise

diagnosis.not_a_hardware_fault: the speaker plays; the microphone responds; pre-checks pass
diagnosis.likely_cause: at 100 cm side-facing the gate tone reaches the microphone weak and diffuse, so the tonal-fraction and tonal-level criteria cannot be met
diagnosis.operator_hypothesis: the operator independently suggested the speaker is too far for the tone to be loud enough
diagnosis.second_run_note: the first run also had the phone playing during the gate because my harness auto-answered a START that required the operator to pause the source; the second run fixed that and still failed, so the source was not the cause

process_note: two identical failures with the same stop reason: per the workflow I stop the branch instead of running a third time
owner: C (measurement criterion). Options for C: raise the gate level, lengthen the gate, use a gate criterion relative to the local noise floor instead of an absolute tonal threshold, or accept a documented not-tested for the positive control at this distance
not_claimed: no claim that the model works or does not work
